Environment: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as any of them.

TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame.
